notes.title: 🎸 Rock Star Life Simulator v.1.0 RELEASED! 🌟
notes.content:
Now you can download the update and play!

At the end of our Early Access journey, we’ve finally reached the full release!
We’d like to thank all the players who have supported us from day one. Shaped by your feedback, Rock Star Life Simulator now offers a bigger, more entertaining, and more detailed experience!

💥 [b]What’s New from v.0.1 to v.1.0?[/b]

🔥 The Most Exciting Additions:
World Tour Update: Perform concerts for your fans across different countries and make your mark on the leaderboards! 🌍🎤
Recording Studio: Open your own music recording studio, record songs for clients with fun mini-games, recruit and test new talents for your team! 🎶
Secret Dealer Missions: Deliver secret goods to the right people and earn rewards. 🕵️‍♂️
Advertising Agency: Run strategic ad campaigns to reach more fans! 📈
Casino V.I.P Area: Try your luck with exclusive games like roulette, fortune wheel, plinko, and aviator. 🎰✨
New Romance Characters: Enjoy more social interactions with new romanceable characters and a stripper area. ❤️
Twitch Integration: Interact with your audience and take your streams to the next level by linking your Twitch account! 📺💬

🎵 Gameplay and Content Updates:
12 new songs! 🎸
Improve the skills of your band members. 🎤🎷
Customize guitar controls to suit your playstyle. 🎵⌨️
Added difficulty levels for guitar playing (Easy and Hard Modes).
Acquire rare items through auctions. 💎

✨ Quality Updates:
Upgraded to a better GPT version for faster and smarter conversations! 🤖
Bug fixes and polishing for a smoother experience. 🛠️
🎉 Are you ready to join our full-release adventure? Add it to your wishlist or start playing now! 🚀

[b]Release Date: 24.01.2025[/b]

[b]We are excited to introduce our new games![/b]

notes.title: 🔥🚨NEW UPDATE!🚨🔥
notes.content:
Hello Rock Stars!

New luxurious life options have been added to the game so you can live like a rock star, and a teammate upgrade feature has been added so you can put on a real musical feast. Boost your charisma with rare items from the auction and become the person everyone admires in the city. Surprise items will be waiting for you in the auction. Keep in mind that these are rare items. 

Another update is that you will be able to improve your bandmates so that you can give a better concert experience to the audience. The better your bandmates are, the more famous you will become and the more money you will earn.

Update Notes;
[list]
[*] Auction mechanics
[*] Developing group friends
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥🚨NEW UPDATE!🚨🔥
notes.content:
[b]Hello Rock Stars![/b]

New songs, outfits and flirtable characters have been added to the game, you can mark the season with new songs and entertain your fan base. With the new clothes, you'll be the center of attention in the city. With new flirtable characters, you're more likely to find the love of your life. New characters are waiting for you in the biggest park in the center of the city!

Another new feature is that you will be able to adjust the keys you use while playing the guitar according to your own wishes. You can adjust the key controls to your liking on the screen that appears before you start playing guitar and writing songs.

[b]Update Notes;[/b]
[list]
[*] New songs
[*] New clothes
[*] New characters to flirt with
[*] Ability to change guitar controls
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥🚨NEW UPDATE SECRET DEALER!🚨🔥
notes.content:
[b]Hello Rock Stars![/b]

A new additional job option has been added to the game, the secret dealer mission, where you can experience the excitement at its peak. You need to secretly find the described package and deliver it to the described person in the described place on time. You must stay away from the police while doing this task or you may get into trouble!

notes.title: 🔥🚨NEW UPDATE Studio Business, Band Member Recruitment and New NPCs🚨🔥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Rock Stars![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424539/c3c39a83d8e44bd2a760a9b664ffdd1c019751e1.png[/img]

[h1]Studio Business[/h1]

Now you can buy a studio and become more recognisable in the music scene while creating a new source of income for yourself. You can earn money and XP by recording other bands' music in the studio. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424539/946b25703a1cf639e7b0b15333d03c4950abf192.png[/img]

[h1]Band Member Recruitment[/h1]

When you buy a studio, you will have the chance to grow your band. You can test the skills of new candidates you invite to the studio. According to the result of the test, you can choose to include or reject the team. The new people you add to your band will contribute to you in different topics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424539/5f36c661b9a2d929fc2723d221cb3e59d1c15e21.png[/img]

[h1]New NPCs[/h1]

New people have arrived in the city and these people will be more familiar to you. The 2 new NPCs have been added in accordance with the language you choose when you enter the game, and are designed to reflect the country where the language you choose is spoken!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424539/f54329e20744cfc44f03889fc6ad797f2a3a3076.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed inability to enter the game after "Steam is not connected" warning.
[*] Added "Break up with lover" button
[*] 1 new song added
[*] Economy regulation
[*] Localization improvements
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/ZKtxvJ6fQY]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44424539/92dd11a497ce6ad7cc93bf06b4705a4af2af8f00.png[/img]
[/url]
